Great to be at AI Engineer Shanghai 2026!

Thanks to everyone who stopped by our booth! It was great connecting with developers, sharing live demos, and exchanging ideas on long-horizon agents and the future of agentic AI.

Our very own Ailing Teng @EileenTal also took the stage to share how Step 5 Preview and our open-source Agent Harness, Step Code, work together to help agents stay on track and reliably execute long-horizon tasks.

We really appreciated all the thoughtful conversations throughout the event.

Stay tuned for what we're building next!

What a weekend at LA Hacks 2026!

Beyond connecting with the community at our booth, we hosted a hands-on workshop to help participants get started with Step 5 Preview and explore what they could build with it.

We also launched the StepFun Challenge and saw teams made especially thoughtful and effective use of our models.

Huge thanks to everyone who stopped by, joined our workshop, or took on the challenge. Congrats to our three winning teams!

We loved being part of LA Hacks and can't wait to see what you build next.

note_tweet.text:
We've also updated Step Code to v0.1.4, our open-source agent harness built around Step 5 Preview.

It helps agents keep track of the goal on long, complex tasks, keep making progress, and check against verifiable results whether the job is actually done.

Four releases since open-sourcing, about one every 3 working days, mostly driven by community feedback. Thank you to everyone who tried it and shared feedback.

https://t.co/LaQCizPq6U

note_tweet.text:
Our technical blog, "Inside Step 5 Preview: Architecture and Training for Agentic Work," covers how architecture and training were co-designed for longer, more complex agent tasks:

• 92-layer narrow-and-deep architecture for implicit multi-hop reasoning 
• Sparse GQA to cut million-token context cost, with 8-token block indexing reducing indexing and top-k overhead to 1/8 
• FP32 precision on key states plus fine-grained gradient clipping for stable training 
• Million-scale verifiable environments 
• RL for long-horizon tasks with context compression built into policy training

https://t.co/dbES4vwaFQ
